Q5779.reason: Saline and heparin lock flushes are most often ordered every 8 hours in standard nursing references, though some policies use 12 hours.

Q5227.reason: UCC 2-328(3) bars withdrawing an item in a without-reserve auction once bidding has been called for and a bid made, so the $100 bid binds the man.

Q6156.reason: The company was a party that deposed the engineer with an opportunity and similar motive to challenge the false-safety-report testimony, so it is admissible former testimony under FRE 804(b)(1) once he is unavailable.
